mintAuthority.summary: nTBILL is a Nest vault share on the Nucleus/BoringVault architecture; the permissioned Teller mints/burns shares when users deposit pUSD at vault NAV, while the Nest-controlled Manager directs Treasury-fund allocation. Both Teller and Manager are owned by a Nest 3-of-6 Safe.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Teller (issuance/redemption)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on the Teller returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982, confirmed as a 3-of-6 Gnosis Safe (v1.3.0+L2) via Safe API. In the Nest/Nucleus BoringVault model the Teller is the only contract that mints and burns vault receipt tokens.

controls.label: Nest Treasury Vault Manager (strategy/admin)
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on the Manager returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982, the same 3-of-6 Safe that owns the Teller. The Manager governs vault strategy and sits in the admin path over BoringVault/Teller issuance.

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096, owner() on both Teller and Manager returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982. Safe API confirmed: 3-of-6 threshold, version 1.3.0+L2, no modules, no guard.

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25295096: owner() on Teller (0x1492062b) and Manager (0xf713a353) both returned 0xa08A0Dc480BD60d1d56C8EeC6c722125eAfEa982. Safe API confirmed 3-of-6 Safe, version 1.3.0+L2, modules [], guard zero. All mint-capable surfaces confirmed. Evidence challenge completed 2026-07-15: Nest publishes issuer-operated hourly NAV and live vault composition, with the latest public vault-data snapshot dated 2026-07-08, but no recurring independent reconciliation of nTBILL supply to portfolio assets was found. Regulation of underlying Treasury products does not prudentially supervise the Nest wrapper issuer. Upgrade-authority follow-up (2026-07-21): the nTBILL token at 0xe72fe64840f4ef80e3ec73a1c749491b5c938cb9 is the exact_match-verified Nucleus BoringVault.sol implementation itself, not a proxy — the EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon storage slots all read zero at Ethereum block 25579998, and its Sourcify ABI has no upgradeTo/upgradeToAndCall entry point. owner() reads the Nest admin contract 0x8fAACdC65de5D78975dF4f9DC4B6548979cEb23A (matching this asset's bridgeRouteRisk finding) and authority() reads 0x0A4F939b5D51157c58bA053275Eaf77a782B4996; these control BoringVault administrative parameters (setAuthority, transferOwnership, setBeforeTransferHook) but cannot swap the vault's deployed bytecode, so mint-critical logic itself is immutable rather than upgradeable. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: the Nest Safe controls the uncapped Teller/Manager issuance path, while issuer NAV and composition data do not reconcile whole supply and no wrapper regulator or independent attestor is evidenced. Wave 2 external verification 2026-08-15: Nest's current vault directory and integration guide add BNB Chain and Solana issuance surfaces but still publish only issuer-operated NAV/composition data, not independent whole-supply reconciliation.
